faq.q: What is the origin of Ishaque?
faq.a: Ishaque is associated with Arabic. Ishaque is a South Asian transliteration of Arabic إِسْحَاق (Isḥāq), the Qur'anic form of Isaac. The source gloss 'The one who worships Allah' is unsupported; the name is a proper name. Same name as isaac, ishaaq and ishaq.
Yes — the underlying form إسحاق is Arabic.

faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
